question:
A cylindrical rod has an outer curved surface area of 1100 cm² . If the length of the rod is 29 cm, then the outer radius (in cm) of the rod, correct to two places of decimal, is

take (pi =(22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equate the given curved surface area directly with its formula: CSA = 2πrh

⇒ 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × r × 29 = 1100

⇒ r = (1100 × 7) ÷ (44 × 29)

⇒ r = 175 ÷ 29

⇒ r ≈ 6.03

**∴ The correct answer is 6.03 cm.**
